mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM ( SELECT DISTINCT ON (contract_id, payment_stage) result_status FROM fgc.cap_check WHERE date_trunc('month', as_of_date) = date_trunc('month', #{month}::date) ORDER BY contract_id, payment_stage, checked_at DESC, cap_check_id DESC ) AS latest_in_month WHERE result_status = 'VIOLATION'

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM ( SELECT DISTINCT ON (contract_id, payment_stage) result_status FROM fgc.cap_check WHERE date_trunc('month', as_of_date) = date_trunc('month', #{month}::date) ORDER BY contract_id, payment_stage, checked_at DESC, cap_check_id DESC ) AS latest_in_month WHERE result_status = 'WARNING'
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM fgc.arbitrage_check WHERE result_status = 'CANDIDATE'

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM fgc.reconciliation_result JOIN ( SELECT DISTINCT ON (settlement_month, payment_stage, insurer_id) reconciliation_run_id FROM fgc.reconciliation_run WHERE date_trunc('month', settlement_month) = date_trunc('month', #{month}::date) ORDER BY settlement_month, payment_stage, insurer_id, created_at DESC, reconciliation_run_id DESC ) AS latest_run ON latest_run.reconciliation_run_id = reconciliation_result.reconciliation_run_id WHERE reconciliation_result.result_type <> 'MATCHED'
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM fgc.exception_case WHERE status IN ('NEW', 'IN_REVIEW')

SELECT ec.exception_case_id AS exceptionCaseId, ec.exception_type AS exceptionType, ec.severity, ic.contract_no AS contractNo, ec.title, ec.status, ec.created_at AS createdAt FROM fgc.exception_case ec LEFT JOIN fgc.insurance_contract ic ON ic.contract_id = ec.contract_id ORDER BY ec.created_at DESC, ec.exception_case_id DESC LIMIT #{limit}

SELECT vr.validation_run_id AS validationRunId, vr.validation_month AS validationMonth, vr.run_no AS runNo, vr.run_type AS runType, vr.status, vr.current_step AS currentStep, triggered.login_id AS triggeredBy, vr.started_at AS startedAt, vr.completed_at AS completedAt, vr.finalized_at AS finalizedAt, finalized.login_id AS finalizedBy, vr.failure_message AS failureMessage FROM fgc.validation_run vr LEFT JOIN fgc.app_user triggered ON triggered.user_id = vr.triggered_by LEFT JOIN fgc.app_user finalized ON finalized.user_id = vr.finalized_by WHERE vr.run_type = 'MONTHLY' ORDER BY vr.created_at DESC, vr.validation_run_id DESC LIMIT #{limit}
